node_01_outpost.title: Tavarre Outpost
node_01_outpost.description: The last neutral dome in the Tavarre corridor — LOA recruiter on the left, Alliance liaison on the right, a fixer in the back who knows the election was rigged. Beyond the airlock, the Eternal Storm howls. Somewhere in it, a hurricane that is also a gate.

node_02_storm.title: Storm Wall
node_02_storm.description: You step into the Wall — wind shear that can throw a mecha, lightning that drinks Energy, whiteout that erases the way back. The storm is the enemy before the enemy. Pass it or be thrown back to the dome.

node_02b_shrine.title: Bazaroth Shrine
node_02b_shrine.description: A storm-scoured shrine cut into the Tavarre rock — black glass, frozen candles, a name carved and re-carved: the hurricane gate's Key. The cult left it. The Way-Bound could be called here.

node_03_duel.title: Psycho-Frame Duel
node_03_duel.description: The hurricane's eye — and the gate inside it. An LOA psycho-frame (pilot amplifying 10x) faces an Alliance psycho-slave (captive psychic in the pod, command pilot at the stick). The duel is the test: win, and the gate is yours to lock or destroy. Lose, and the storm takes you.

node_04_reward.title: Eye of the Gate
node_04_reward.description: The wind stops. The gate hums — toadstools, or a mirror, or the hurricane itself. A Skeleton Key could lock it, open it, or shatter it forever. A Wooden Chest sits at the threshold, storm-scoured and humming with salvage.
